source_title: Micro Units Development & Refinance Agency Official Scheme Guidelines
target_beneficiaries: Non-corporate, non-farm small and micro enterprises seeking loans up to Rs. 10-20 Lakhs

eligibility_criteria.business_nature: Non-farm income generating micro/small business in manufacturing, trading, or service sector, including allied agricultural activities (poultry, dairy, beekeeping, fishery)
eligibility_criteria.credit_history: Must not be a defaulter to any commercial bank, cooperative bank, or financial institution
loan_categories: Shishu: Loans up to Rs. 50,000 for early-stage micro entrepreneurs
Kishore: Loans above Rs. 50,000 and up to Rs. 5,00,000 for established small units seeking expansion
Tarun: Loans above Rs. 5,00,000 and up to Rs. 10,00,000 (extended up to Rs. 20,00,000 for entrepreneurs who repaid previous Tarun loans successfully)
exclusions: Direct crop cultivation (pure farming crop loans covered under KCC rather than MUDRA)
Individuals with defaulting loan history in CIBIL/credit bureaus

benefits.collateral: No collateral security or third-party guarantee required for loans up to Rs. 10 Lakhs
benefits.processing_fee: Nil processing fee for Shishu and Kishore loans across most banks
benefits.mudra_card: MUDRA RuPay Debit Card issued for working capital overdraft needs

online_steps: Visit official Udyamimitra portal https://udyamimitra.in/ or JanSamarth portal https://www.jansamarth.in/
Register an applicant profile with name, email, and mobile number
Select 'Apply for MUDRA Loan' and choose loan category (Shishu, Kishore, or Tarun)
Enter proposed business enterprise details, activity, estimated cost, and required loan amount
Upload required business proposals, KYC documents, and quotes
Select preferred lender bank/branch and submit application
application_process.offline_option: Submit application directly at any branch of Commercial Banks, Regional Rural Banks (RRBs), Small Finance Banks, or NBFC-MFIs

required_documents: Proof of Identity (Aadhaar Card, Voter ID, PAN Card, Driving License)
Proof of Residence (Electricity Bill, Aadhaar, Telephone Bill, Ration Card)
Udyam Enterprise Registration Certificate / Trade License if business is registered
Quotation of machinery, tools, or items to be purchased with supplier details
Bank account statements for the last 6 months (for Kishore and Tarun categories)
Proof of SC/ST/OBC category certificate if claiming affirmative lending priority
